pages.text: A tiny click sounds as Pia the camera opens her eye. Light begins painting a picture.
Light enters the lens. Inside, the camera turns light into a picture we can see later.
Pictures stop a moment in time. Smiles, jumps, and waves can stay forever in a photo.
Cameras live in many places. Phones, tablets, and special cameras all use lenses.
Bright light helps pictures look sharp. Very dark places can make photos blurry.
A button press tells Pia to capture. The camera listens and saves the picture quickly.
Photos can be saved and shared. They help people remember special days.
Cameras do not choose moments. People decide what is important to capture.
Some cameras can record moving pictures too. Videos show motion and sound together.
When the day ends, Pia rests her lens. Tomorrow brings new moments to catch.
